issues.title: The caret and selection follow their text when a frontmatter toggle, property edit, link rewrite or external reload rewrites the open note
issues.trigger: Caret in the body of the active note, editor focused. Press Cmd+D (adds `_favorite: true`, about 16 chars above the caret) or Cmd+E (`_organized: false` -> `true`, 1 char shorter), or let a watcher reload of the clean tab bring an edit above the caret, or a link rewrite / task toggle change text above it. Keep typing without clicking.
issues.what_to_build: Every external doc replace keeps the caret at its old numeric offset instead of mapping it through the change. The content-sync effect (src/lib/core/markdown-editor/MarkdownEditor.svelte:627) reads `selection.main.head` from the old doc, and replaceDoc (:182-186) dispatches the `docDiff` changes together with an explicit `selection: EditorSelection.cursor(cursorPos)`. CodeMirror reads an explicit selection as post-change coordinates and does not map it (node_modules/@codemirror/state/dist/index.d.ts:865, index.js:2403-2415). So after a write above the caret, the caret sits N characters off and the next keystrokes land in the wrong place; a range selection also collapses to a cursor. Autosave then persists the misplaced text. Fix direction: let CodeMirror map the current selection through the diff (omit `selection`, or pass `state.selection.map(changeSet)`), keeping a clamp only for the fresh-state fallback (:173-180) where there is nothing to map. Apply the same to showTabState (:213-234): on a revisit the saved state's own selection should map through the background-write diff instead of being overwritten with the unmapped saved `cursorPos` (:224).

issues.title: Keyboard edits next to the hidden frontmatter never change its fences
issues.trigger: A note with frontmatter (properties, _type, meta-bind) is open in live preview. The user presses Cmd+Up (or ArrowUp from the first body line) and then Enter to make room at the top. Or the user deletes the first body line with Backspace held down, and the key repeat runs past the start of the line. Nothing visible happens on the hidden lines. The fence breaks, the raw YAML appears as body text (the closing `---` turns `status: todo` into a setext heading), and autosave writes it.
issues.what_to_build:
The frontmatter lines are hidden with per-line `Decoration.replace({})` plus a display:none line class (src/lib/core/markdown-editor/extensions/live-preview/core/hide-lines.ts:14-20, called from plugins/frontmatter-field.ts:23). Only the mouse path is guarded: `frontmatterClick` (plugins/frontmatter-field.ts:88) remaps a press in the top padding to the first body line, and its own doc comment says keyboard moves are not changed (:79, :86). Nothing under src/lib defines atomicRanges, a transactionFilter or a changeFilter, so keyboard commands act on the hidden fence. Cmd+Up puts the selection at 0, and Enter or Delete there edits the opening `---`. Backspace at the start of the first body line deletes the line break after the closing fence (`---First line`), and further Backspaces delete fence characters. After that, `findFrontmatterBlock` (parsers/frontmatter.ts:17-30) no longer finds the block, or it closes the block at a later `---` horizontal rule.

Fix direction: install the guard with `frontmatterField`, so it applies only while the frontmatter is hidden, and limit it to user transactions. (1) A selection that a user `select.*` transaction puts inside the hidden range is clamped to the start of the first body line. This covers Cmd+Up, ArrowUp and PageUp, plus shift-extends, which clamp their head. (2) A user `input.*` or `delete.*` change that touches the hidden range, including the line break after the closing fence, is dropped or narrowed to the body. Backspace at the start of the first body line then does nothing to the fence. Do not make the whole range atomic: CodeMirror's deleteCharBackward deletes an atomic range whole, so Backspace at the first body line would remove the entire frontmatter. Programmatic writes must pass unchanged: the Properties panel, meta-bind writers, tab loads and setState carry no input or delete userEvent. The e2e at e2e/specs/live-preview/click-reveal/frontmatter.spec.ts:53-65 pins today's ArrowUp behavior (the cursor lands on the first hidden line). That test only recorded the current behavior (Issue 03 Notes); change it to expect the first body line, and say so in the commit.
